|game_text=USED: If Obi-Wan on table, activate up to 3 Force. STARTING: If a Tatooine site on table, deploy Obi-Wan (regardless of Objective restrictions) and his matching weapon there. When you draw your starting hand, draw three cards instead of eight. Place Interrupt in hand.
|errata_history=Versions of [[Krayt Dragon Howl (V)]] in [[Virtual Set 8: Jabba's Court]], in date order (2 versions). Slip texts are quoted as printed: ▼ and ▲ are the slips' arrow icons (deploy from / take into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle), and the immunity and pilot icons are the ones explained in each sheet's icon key (see [[Virtual card icons]]). Found while adding the original pre-Remaster slips (Bill, 12 November 2026).
* '''Original''' (this page): release sheet “Virtual Set #8” (Players Committee; released 24 November 2004; PDF dated 24 November 2004), page 1, slip 10 — [https://web.archive.org/web/20041205113015/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/Resources/VirtualSet8Final.pdf VirtualSet8Final.pdf on swccgpc.com] (Internet Archive capture of 5 December 2004), announced in the [https://web.archive.org/web/20041204170841/http://www.swccgpc.com/interior.htm Committee's news post of 24 November 2004]: “USED: If Obi-Wan on table, activate up to 3 Force. STARTING: If a Tatooine site on table, deploy Obi-Wan (regardless of Objective restrictions) and his matching weapon there. When you draw your starting hand, draw three cards instead of eight. Place Interrupt in hand.” The slip is the old pre-template slip the Committee used before its December 2006 Remaster: the Decipher-style lower half with the slip mark “8•10” at bottom right and no expansion icon.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Krayt Dragon Howl (V) (Virtual Set 8) (Errata)]]): the Remaster sheet (official text as of 4 December 2006; [https://web.archive.org/web/20071026143738/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards8.pdf Internet Archive capture of 26 October 2007; later 2007 re-edits included], slip 10), in the Committee's Remaster template: “USED: If Obi-Wan on table, activate up to 3 Force. STARTING: Deploy Obi-Wan (regardless of Objective deployment restrictions) and his matching weapon to a Tatooine site from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. When you draw your starting hand, draw three cards instead of eight. Place this Interrupt in hand.” '''What changed:''' the Remaster rewrote the slip in the Committee's later wording (full text above; icons written out in words here). This is the current text of the Virtual Original card.
